findings.issue: Wrong time reading: ９時 is always read くじ, never きゅうじ.
findings.current: きゅうじになってはじめてかれわかえってきた。
findings.suggested: くじになってはじめてかれわかえってきた。

findings.issue: Follows the wrong kana reading: kyuuji should be kuji (９時=くじ).
findings.current: kyuujininattehajimetekarewakaettekita.

findings.issue: Reading of ９ before 時 is く (９時=くじ), not きゅう.
findings.current: きゅう

findings.issue: Stale internal QA remark in a learner-facing note: it complains about a gloss_en 'that' that no longer exists (the gloss is already 'he'/'ele'). Tool-talk should be removed.
findings.current: 代名詞 'ele' (彼); gloss_en 'that' impreciso

findings.issue: 着きたい is desiderative ('want to arrive'); 'I have to be there' recasts it as obligation and contradicts lit_en and both expl fields, which teach たい = want.
findings.current: I have to be there by 7:00.
findings.suggested: I want to get there by 7, though...

findings.issue: の in ７月の工業生産 is genitive; 'From July' misreads it as a temporal starting point (から). The literal mirror should be 'July's industrial production'.
findings.current: From July, industrial production sharply increased.

findings.issue: False absolute rule: に is optional after ごろ, not banned — ６時ごろに起きた is perfectly correct and textbook-standard. As written it teaches a nonexistent prohibition.
findings.current: Note that with ごろ the time particle に is not used, since ごろ itself already fulfills that role.
findings.suggested: Note that after ごろ the particle に is optional (６時ごろに起きた is also correct); here it is simply omitted.

findings.issue: Same false rule in Portuguese: に after ごろ is optional, not proibida — ６時ごろに起きた é correto.
findings.current: Note que com ごろ não se usa a partícula に de tempo, pois o próprio ごろ já cumpre esse papel.
findings.suggested: Note que depois de ごろ a partícula に é opcional (６時ごろに起きた também é correto); aqui ela foi apenas omitida.

findings.issue: Month name misread: ４月 (April) is always しがつ, never よんがつ.
findings.current: ごがつわよんがつのあとにくる。
findings.suggested: ごがつわしがつのあとにくる。

findings.issue: Follows the wrong kana: yongatsu should be shigatsu (４月=しがつ).
findings.current: gogatsuwayongatsunoatonikuru.

findings.issue: ４ before 月 in a month name is read し (４月=しがつ), not よん.
findings.current: よん

findings.issue: Numeral read digit-by-digit: ５０００円 is ごせんえん, not ごれいれいれいえん (go-rei-rei-rei is not a Japanese number reading).
findings.current: ごれいれいれいえんばかりもっている。
findings.suggested: ごせんえんばかりもっている。

findings.issue: Follows the wrong kana: goreireirei should be gosen (５０００=ごせん).
findings.current: goreireireienbakarimotteiru.

findings.issue: Reading of ５０００ is ごせん, not digit-by-digit ごれいれいれい.
findings.current: ごれいれいれい

findings.issue: Period misplaced inside the closing parenthesis (en version has it correctly outside).
findings.current: que descreve um estado contínuo (ter/possuir algo no momento.)
findings.suggested: que descreve um estado contínuo (ter/possuir algo no momento).

findings.issue: Numeral read digit-by-digit: ４０ is よんじゅう, not よんれい.
findings.current: よんれいちかいはずだ。
findings.suggested: よんじゅうちかいはずだ。

findings.issue: Follows the wrong kana: yonrei should be yonjuu (４０=よんじゅう).
findings.current: yonreichikaihazuda.

findings.issue: Reading of ４０ is よんじゅう, not digit-by-digit よんれい.
findings.current: よんれい

findings.issue: Period misplaced inside the closing parenthesis (en version has it correctly outside).
findings.current: sem partícula no meio (é o uso afirmativo padrão de はずだ.)
findings.suggested: sem partícula no meio (é o uso afirmativo padrão de はずだ).

findings.issue: ３０分 read digit-by-digit and without gemination: さんれいふん is wrong; correct is さんじゅっぷん (or さんじっぷん).
findings.current: さんれいふんおきにでます。
findings.suggested: さんじゅっぷんおきにでます。

findings.issue: Follows the wrong kana: sanreifun should be sanjuppun (３０分=さんじゅっぷん).
findings.current: sanreifunokinidemasu.

findings.issue: Reading of ３０ is さんじゅう (here さんじゅっ before the geminated ぷん of 分), not digit-by-digit さんれい.
findings.current: さんれい

findings.issue: 分 after ３０ geminates: ３０分 = さんじゅっぷん, so the in-context token reading is ぷん, not ふん.
findings.current: ふん

findings.issue: 行った is いった here (行く 'to go' — experience of having been somewhere), not おこなった (行う 'to carry out'). The expl itself concedes the verb is 行く.
findings.current: に、さんどおこなったことがある。
findings.suggested: に、さんどいったことがある。

findings.issue: Follows the wrong kana: okonatta should be itta (行った=いった in this context).
findings.current: ni,sandookonattakotogaaru.

findings.issue: In-context reading of 行っ is いっ (行く), not おこなっ (行う); the token's own gloss and note already say 行く.
findings.current: おこなっ

findings.issue: Internal tooling talk ('the parser read the verb as...') does not belong in learner content and becomes stale/contradictory once the reading is corrected to いった; delete the aside.
findings.current: Note: the parser read the verb as 行う ('to carry out'), but in context it is 行く ('to go'); that's why the translation uses 'go'.

findings.issue: Same internal tooling aside in Portuguese ('o analisador leu...'); remove it once the reading is fixed.
findings.current: Observação: o analisador leu o verbo como 行う ("realizar"), mas no contexto trata-se de 行く ("ir"); por isso a tradução usa "ir".

findings.issue: ２つ is ふたつ; ふつつ is not a Japanese reading.
findings.current: いちどにふつつのことをしようとおもうな。
findings.suggested: いちどにふたつのことをしようとおもうな。

findings.issue: Follows the wrong kana: futsutsu should be futatsu (２つ=ふたつ).
findings.current: ichidonifutsutsunokotooshiyoutoomouna.

findings.issue: ２ before the native counter つ is read ふた (ふたつ), not ふつ.
findings.current: ふつ

findings.issue: Duplicated tokenization: tokens[0] '１' and tokens[1] '度' (both all-null) duplicate tokens[2] '１度', so concatenated surfaces read １度１度に… and no longer reconstruct the sentence. Keep only the merged １度 token.
findings.suggested: remover os tokens divididos '１' e '度'; manter apenas o token '１度'

findings.issue: European Portuguese tu-form 'não penses'; pt-BR standard (você) is 'não pense'. Project rule bans pt-PT wording.
findings.current: しようと思うな literalmente é "não penses em fazer", ou seja, "não tente fazer".
findings.suggested: しようと思うな literalmente é "não pense em fazer", ou seja, "não tente fazer".

findings.issue: Same EP tu-form 'penses' inside the literal mirror; pt-BR uses 'pense'.
findings.current: De uma vez duas coisas fazer-vou que penses-não.
findings.suggested: De uma vez duas coisas fazer-vou que pense-não.
